1) 执行 gpstate -e 查看处于非预期角色的 segment 及其所在: 1) Run gpstate -e to see which segments are in an unexpected role and which hosts they are on; 2) Check whether the host of the original primary is down or has a disk failure and fix the hardware first; 3) Run gprecoverseg to recover the failed segment and wait until gpstate -m shows everything back to Synchronized; 4) Finally run gprecoverseg -r to return the primary/mirror roles to their original distribution and confirm overall health with gpstate -s.
1) 执行 gpstate -m 确认是哪些镜像段的 Data Status 异: 1) Run gpstate -m to identify which mirror segments have an abnormal Data Status; 2) For Resynchronizing, watch the progress (gpstate -e); resynchronizing large tables legitimately takes a while, so just wait; 3) For Not Syncing, run gprecoverseg for an incremental recovery, and gprecoverseg -F for a full recovery if that fails; 4) Once recovery completes, run gprecoverseg -r to restore the original primary/mirror distribution so primaries do not stay concentrated on a few hosts.
有镜像段不处于 Passive 状态，说明它已经接管为主段或本身已失效，集群的主: A mirror segment is not in the Passive state, meaning it has taken over as primary or has itself failed. The cluster's primary/mirror layout has drifted from the plan and node load will become unbalanced.
有镜像段的数据同步状态不是 Synchronized（正在重同步或已中断），此时: A mirror segment's data synchronization state is not Synchronized (it is resynchronizing or has broken). If the corresponding primary fails now it cannot fail over automatically and the cluster has lost its redundancy.
